journey.name: custom fee wallet switch prepares coins
journey.description: Verifies that choosing a custom on-chain fee from a Lightning confirmation prepares coin selection after returning through the fee picker. Use a dedicated simulator and disposable regtest wallet with sufficient Savings and Spending balances, manual coin selection enabled, and a valid unified invoice payable from either balance. Never swipe to pay or authorize a payment in this journey. This two-stage return through the fee picker is iOS-specific. Android returns directly to confirmation when applying a custom fee, so it has no intermediate fee-picker wait to check.

actions.action: Open the unified invoice and continue to confirmation (id "SendConfirm") with Spending selected
Tap Show Details (id "SendConfirmToggleDetails"), then the Fee and Speed row
Choose Custom and enter a valid fee rate
Tap Continue and wait for the fee picker to appear. Stay there for two seconds
Verify the fee picker remains visible and manual coin selection has not opened
Tap Continue to return to confirmation
Verify the coin selection screen opens and lists available Savings coins
Select enough coins for the amount and fee, then tap Continue
On confirmation, tap Show Details (id "SendConfirmToggleDetails") if details are collapsed
Verify confirmation (id "SendConfirm") shows Savings and the chosen custom fee
Close the send sheet without paying and verify no send error toast appears
Enable automatic coin selection, reopen the unified invoice with Spending selected, and repeat the custom-fee steps through the fee picker
Verify confirmation (id "SendConfirm") shows Savings and the chosen custom fee without opening manual coin selection; close without paying
